title: A Prayer for Our Brothers and Sisters in Christ in Nigeria
summary: Pastor Daniel Whyte III prays for God’s protection over brothers and sisters in Christ across Nigeria.
body_html:
Pastor Daniel Whyte III shared this word during his October 9 sermon, 'Prayer, Love, and Advice for the 144,000 Homeless People in Atlanta.' Watch the full sermon here: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158.

“I pray for my dear brothers and sisters in Christ in Nigeria. Surround them with Your protection.”

— Daniel Whyte III

Watch the full sermon: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158
takeaway: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” (Psalm 91:1, KJV)
